text: Flying cars come to life with Manus Game Dev. @alanalyzing built this game with Manus Game Dev, with tracks in San Francisco, Tokyo, and Singapore. Describe your idea and turn it into a playable game—code, art, and sound included. alan chan@alanalyzing Started from a Roadster concept trailer, then built this full-stack game with @ManusAI Game Dev!
